text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing
with Biwa Hayahide—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aah! If it isn't Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I was actually looking for someone just now!
Come join our game of hide-and-seek, Hayahide!"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Glasses big sis, let's play!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm on my way home.
I didn't come here to play around.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Just one last match, please!
Pleeeease, pleeeease, pleeeeeeaaase!!”

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: I wanna do it! Pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...The last kid who got here hasn't played even once yet.
So think of it as helping someone out... okay?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Curfew is fast approaching, and yet...
Haa... Honestly."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun. Um—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun. Um—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
Sorry for dragging you along with me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Teio.
Which one is the girl you said came last?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, about that—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: I-It's me...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, you seem like a well-mannered young lady. I have a favor to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mind if I hide with you?
I have a strategy... but well,
it's been a while since I played hide-and-seek.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: ...A strategy?

And so began the game of
hide-and-seek with the kids...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Fueh~... Guess only Hayahide and the others are left, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm surprised, though. I never thought I'd be the one found first...

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Right? Normally, she's way worse at hide-and-seek.

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
It's too late to ask, "Can I play hide-and-seek too?"
Aww, if you're this strong,
I gotta invite you sooner next time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.
And five minutes later—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Found it at last~!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~ You found me out~

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, but being able to stay hidden this long is all thanks to your support.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
No, Big Sis taught me—
Ah! That was supposed to be a secret!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, no need to keep it a secret.
Next time, teach the trick to your friends too,
and everyone can enjoy it together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "So next time, make sure you ask everyone 'Can I play too?' before it gets dark, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

And so, Biwa Hayahide and the others
parted ways with the children, all smiles.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I appreciate how quickly you catch on.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Teio-kun!
And the children, too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Believe it or not, my little sister and I used to be known as the neighborhood's undisputed hide-and-seek champions.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Why don't we show them that power of yours!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, all right!
Everyone, hide!

And so began the game of
hide-and-seek with the kids...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: First, under the slide!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, they found me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The woods next to the bench!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: Ehh~, whyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And as for the remaining Teio...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In the tree right behind Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "No way!? How'd you figure it out?!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I simply plugged the size and number of the kids
and playground equipment into a formula.
Now then, did you all have fun too?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yes!
With a similarly satisfied expression, Biwa Hayahide accompanied Tokai Teio back to the dorms.
